## Learning goals

By the end of this project:

- I will be able to measure real tools and design an organizer that supports access, counting, storage, and safe handling.
- I will be able to test a prototype and revise the design from evidence.

This is important because a useful organizer must fit the tools, the user, and the place where it will be used.

## Project route

1. Use the [Tool Organizer Gallery](../tools/tool-organizer-gallery/index.qmd) to compare construction ideas.
2. Measure the tools and decide how they will be supported and removed.
3. Use the [Fabrication Plate Builder](../tools/plate-builder/index.qmd) for plates, rings, and repeated holder holes.
4. Use the [Laser-Cut Leg & Support Builder](../tools/leg-builder/index.qmd) when the organizer needs a stand or support.
5. Find reusable geometry in [Laser-Cutting Files and Resources](../../teaching-materials/laser-cutting/index.qmd).
6. Make a small fit test, build the prototype, photograph it, and record the next revision.

[Open the detailed Tool Organizer Project notes](../03-laser-cutting/06-tool-holder.qmd).
